articles.title: 9-page red-ink note and walk-in psychiatry visit deepen mystery around Bengaluru businessman C J Roy’s suicide
articles.summary: C J Roy, a 57-year-old high-profile real estate businessman, died by suicide in Bengaluru. His death, confirmed over a month after the incident, occurred amidst an ongoing Income Tax department probe at his central Bengaluru office. This incident brings to light the pressures involved during financial investigations involving prominent figures.

articles.title: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta approves Rs 1,200 cr grant for DTC salaries, pensions and transport modernisation
articles.summary: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta has approved a substantial grant of ₹1,200 crore for the Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC). This critical funding is designated to cover employee salaries and pensions, alongside initiating the modernization of the capital's transport infrastructure. This decision aims to bolster public transport services and ensure their efficient operation for citizens.

articles.title: Venture capitalists must increase support for defence start-ups: NITI Aayog's Saraswat
articles.summary: NITI Aayog member and former DRDO director general VK Saraswat urged venture capitalists to significantly increase financial support for Indian defence start-ups. Saraswat highlighted the considerable progress made by these start-ups, emphasizing that greater investment is crucial for fostering indigenous innovation. This call aims to bolster India's self-reliance in defence manufacturing and strengthen national security capabilities by backing emerging domestic technologies.

articles.title: How corporate layoffs and the US H-1B to green card system leave skilled workers in prolonged immigration limbo
articles.summary: This article discusses how corporate layoffs in the US, combined with the complexities of the H-1B visa and green card system, are creating prolonged immigration uncertainty for skilled workers. It highlights the challenges faced by these professionals who find themselves in limbo due to economic shifts and bureaucratic processes, impacting their career and personal stability in the United States.

articles.title: Diesel Engines Need Air, Submarines Run Underwater, So How Do Diesel Submarines Work?
articles.summary: Submarines acquire air through two main methods: surfacing above water or employing a snorkel in shallow depths. A snorkel is a pipe designed to extend just above the surface, drawing crucial air into the submarine. This innovation enables extended submerged operations without needing to fully surface, significantly enhancing their stealth capabilities and operational endurance for naval missions.

articles.title: India’s textile sector at an inflection point as global tariff barriers ease; Arvind Fashion, Raymond Lifestyle top buys
articles.summary: India's textile industry is entering a crucial phase as recent tariff relaxations by the US significantly boost its global competitiveness. This development is resetting the economics of the sector, offering Indian textiles a stronger position in the international market. The move is expected to drive growth and expand opportunities for the industry, making it a key focus for national economic strategy.
